statusRules.zero: API published numeric exactly 0; no observations in selected 2024 subset

quantitativeData.displayRounding: One decimal place only in labels. Source and CSV retain unrounded original percentages. A positive value below 0.05% is labelled less than 0.05%, never 0%.
